_note: Cinder Court (coal room) prop set. Every texturePrompt forbids baked glow on purpose: this room's whole thesis is that coal is the COLD thing occluding the heat behind it, and a lump with orange baked into its albedo destroys that read before the lighting ever gets a say. Iron is specified as worn dark grey rather than black for the same reason the runtime material is #2b2320 - soot-black albedo sits near 8% reflectance and renders as a hole no matter how much light hits it.
